manipulation_debut.title: Erevane
manipulation_debut.narrator: You leave before the four can answer.
manipulation_debut.text:
You don't run.

Running would mean you're afraid.

You walk.

The black blade pressed against your side.
Your throat still marked by the heat of Ikar's blade.

Behind you, the camp stays silent.

No one shouts your name.

Not yet.

That's almost worse.

Aryn could have spoken.
Taera could have followed you.
Vael could have appeared in front of you with some bad joke.
Ikar could have blocked your way.

Nothing.

So you keep going.

Somewhere ahead, Erevane is waiting for you.

And for the first time since Cendral,
you know exactly where to go.

dernier_regard.title: The Last Look
dernier_regard.text:
You turn around.

The camp is still there.

Small.
Gray.
Fragile under the dawn.

You make out a silhouette.

Aryn.

She is standing.

She isn't following you.

She is only watching you.

Even from far away, you can tell she understands.

Not that she accepts it.

That she understands.

It's almost enough to bring you back.

Then you think of the blade at your throat.

Of Ikar.
Of their silences.
Of that sentence.

*Ready for anything.*

You turn back.

This time, you don't look anymore.

ne_pas_retourner.title: No Way Back
ne_pas_retourner.text:
The sun climbs.

You walk for a long time.

At first, every sound behind you makes your heart pound.

A branch.
A bird.
The wind in the grass.

You expect to see all four of them burst out.

But no one comes.

Loneliness arrives slowly.

Then all at once.

And when it's there,
you notice something strange.

The blade is calmer.

Less cold.

As if it, too, breathes better far from them.

choices.text: Keep walking alone a while longer.

route_seul.title: A Moment Alone
route_seul.text:
You spend the day in the hills.

No voices.
No advice.
No worried glances.

No one tells you to breathe.
No one tells you to lower the blade.
No one watches your hands.

You thought the silence would frighten you.

But no.

Silence doesn't judge you.

That evening, you light a fire.

Not with wood.

With the blade.

A violet light licks at the stones.

It doesn't burn.

It holds the warmth.

You smile in spite of yourself.

Maybe they were wrong.

Maybe, alone, you can learn another way.

retrouver_erevane.title: The One Who Waits
retrouver_erevane.text:
Erevane is there.

Sitting beside an ancient milestone.

As if he had never doubted you would come.

He doesn't smile too quickly.

He doesn't stand up too quickly.

He lets you come closer.

Maybe that's what lowers your guard.

He doesn't ask anything of you.

**"You left."**

**"Yes."**

**"Did they try to stop you?"**

You think of Aryn standing in the dawn.

**"No."**

Erevane lowers his eyes.

**"Then they were afraid of what they would have done, had they tried."**

The sentence slips into you far too easily.

erevane_doute.title: Doubt
erevane_doute.text:
**"I don't know anymore."**

Erevane nods.

Not like someone who has won.

Like someone who understands.

**"That's honest."**

He hands you a waterskin.

You drink.

**"Beware of people who never doubt."** he says.

You think of Ikar.

Then of yourself.

**"And people who doubt too much?"**

Erevane finally smiles.

**"Those ones are exhausting."**

You laugh.

A short laugh.
Broken.

But a laugh all the same.

erevane_ecoute.title: Listening
erevane_ecoute.text:
Erevane doesn't say much that night.

He listens.

You tell him about Cendral.
Marek.
The blade.
The Four.
The throat.
The fear.

Sometimes you stop, certain you've said too much.

But he never looks at you like a catastrophe.

Never like a weapon.

Never like a mission.

He looks at you like a person.

And that is exactly what you needed.

That's why you don't see the trap.

Because a trap that looks like compassion
makes no sound when it snaps shut.

ordre_mensonge.title: What the Order Hides
ordre_mensonge.text:
**"Why would the Order hide that?"**

Erevane stirs the embers with a stick.

**"Because a world built on fear has to protect its fear."**

**"What does that mean?"**

**"That if they admit Chaos can be something other than a threat..."**
**"...then they must admit they've been wrong for three hundred years."**

He looks at you.

**"Institutions sometimes prefer to sacrifice one person rather than give up a certainty."**

You would like to find that exaggerated.

But you can still feel Ikar's blade under your throat.

choices.text: A detail that doesn't add up.

erevane_nuance.title: The Nuance
erevane_nuance.text:
**"The Four are not the Order."**

Erevane nods.

**"No."**

The answer surprises you.

**"They may love you sincerely."**

The word hurts.

**"Then why..."**

**"Because love isn't always enough to disobey a fear you learned as a child."**

He doesn't insult them.

He doesn't even really accuse them.

That's worse.

He makes their betrayal sadder.

And therefore more believable.

lecon_chaos.title: The First Lesson
lecon_chaos.text:
The next day, Erevane leads you to a clearing burned long ago.

No tree has grown back.

**"Chaos is not destruction."** he says.

You look at the dead earth.

**"Bad example."**

He smiles.

**"Chaos is what remains when imposed forms break."**

**"That sounds a lot like destruction."**

**"Only to those who loved the old shape."**

He sets a stone down in front of you.

**"Cut it."**

You draw your blade.

The black blade absorbs the light.

Then it sings.

pierre_douce.title: The Stone
pierre_douce.text:
You strike gently.

The blade slides into the stone.

No shock.
No sound.

As if the stone had forgotten it was supposed to resist.

A violet line opens.

The stone splits in two.

Erevane watches.

**"You see?"**

**"I cut it."**

**"No."**

He picks up the two halves.

**"You reminded it that it could be something other than whole."**

It's absurd.

And yet.

The blade in your hand seems lighter.

pierre_choisit.title: The Blade Chooses
pierre_choisit.text:
You don't guide the strike.

You let the blade move.

The world turns violet.

One second.

The stone is gone.

Not broken.

Not reduced to dust.

Absent.

A circle of earth sinks around you.

Erevane doesn't step back.

He stares at the empty space where the stone was.

His eyes shine.

Just for a second.

Then he bows his head.

**"Magnificent."**

The word frightens you.

And pleases you.

progres.title: Progress
progres.text:
You learn fast.

Too fast.

The black blade is no longer merely cold.
It responds.

It absorbs sounds when you need silence.
It cuts through shadows when the night is too heavy.
It opens paths through the rocks.

Erevane says you are not losing control.

You are giving up the wrong habits.

The ones the Order would have taught you.

The ones the Four would have forced on you.

Sometimes you think of them.

Less often each day.

ils_te_cherchent.title: They're Looking for You
ils_te_cherchent.text:
**"They're looking for me?"**

Erevane closes the book he was reading.

**"Yes."**

Your heart tightens.

**"To bring me back?"**

**"Probably."**

**"To help me?"**

Erevane doesn't answer right away.

He lets you fill the silence.

You fill it with every wrong answer.

At last he says:

**"They probably think that's what they're doing."**

You nod.

That's it.

That's exactly it.

They think.

premiere_perte.title: The Merchant
premiere_perte.text:
The first real accident happens on a bridge.

A merchant refuses to let you pass.

Not out of malice.

He recognized the blade.

His hands shake on the reins.

**"Turn back."**

You try to speak.

The horse panics.
The cart tips over.
A child screams in the back.

You reach out your hand.

The blade reacts before you do.

Chaos stops the cart.

But the bridge cracks.

A whole arch collapses into the river.

No one dies.

This time.

The merchant looks at you.

Not with gratitude.

With horror.

choices.text: Leave before they call for help.

reparer_pont.title: Repair
reparer_pont.text:
You try to repair it.

You lay your hand on the cracked stone.

You think of Taera.

Of the way she touches the ground before she acts.

The stone trembles.

For a moment, you think you can do it.

Then a violet fissure runs through the remaining arch.

The merchant backs away.

**"Stop."**

His voice is soft.

Pleading.

**"Please."**

So you stop.

You understand something.

Even when you want to repair,
people are afraid of what your hands can do.

partir_pont.title: Leave
partir_pont.text:
You leave.

Behind you, the merchant calls the child by name.

Again.
Again.

The child finally answers.

You exhale.

You didn't know you had been holding your breath.

Erevane walks beside you.

He doesn't blame you for anything.

It's almost pleasant.

It's almost worse.

erevane_console.title: Consolation
erevane_console.text:
**"You saved the child."** Erevane says.

**"I destroyed the bridge."**

**"A bridge can be rebuilt."**

**"What if someone had died?"**

He walks a long time without answering.

Then:

**"All powers have a cost."**

**"Easy to say when you're not the one paying."**

He stops.

For the first time, he looks hurt.

**"Do you think I've paid nothing?"**

You don't know what to answer.

So he starts walking again.

And you follow him.

erevane_perte.title: What He Lost
erevane_perte.text:
**"What did you lose?"**

Erevane doesn't turn around.

**"A brother."**

The word hangs between you.

Simple.
Heavy.

**"Because of Chaos?"**

**"Because of those who claimed to understand it."**

He keeps walking.

**"My brother believed Caël could be saved."**
**"He was branded a heretic."**
**"Erased from the archives."**

At last he stops.

**"They made his voice disappear."**

His eyes are wet.

You believe him.

Because it's true.

It's only incomplete.

lecon_memoire.title: Memory
lecon_memoire.text:
Erevane takes you into ruins covered in moss.

Names are carved into the walls.

Some have been erased.

**"Chaos keeps what the world rejects."** he says.

You run your fingers over a broken inscription.

A pain runs through you.

Not your own.

Someone pleading.
Someone fleeing.
Someone deliberately forgotten.

You pull your hand away.

**"What was that?"**

**"A memory."**

**"Whose memory?"**

**"Of everyone we decided to stop hearing."**

The black blade trembles.

As if it recognized the erased names.

ecouter_memoires.title: The Voices
ecouter_memoires.text:
You listen.

A mistake.

Or a miracle.

The voices rise.

Too many of them.

Children.
Old people.
Soldiers.
Failed bearers.
People burned by a prophecy before they had even acted.

Their fears enter your chest.

Their rages too.

You fall to your knees.

Erevane places a hand on your shoulder.

**"Don't push them away."**

**"It hurts."**

**"Yes."**

His voice trembles.

**"At last, someone hears them."**

So you keep listening.

Because how do you refuse the dead?

ville_rouge.title: The Red City
ville_rouge.text:
Sorn is a red city.

Red bricks.
Red roofs.
Red dust in the streets.

You should have gone around it.

But Erevane needs ink.
Supplies.
Maps.

And you need to prove you can cross a town without a catastrophe.

For an hour, it works.

No one recognizes you.

Then a child sees the blade under your coat.

A finger points.

The silence returns.

Always the same.

Like an old song you hate
but know by heart.

sorn_ignore.title: Ignore Them
sorn_ignore.text:
You lower your eyes.

You keep walking.

A man murmurs:

**"It's him."**

You keep going.

A woman answers:

**"The Blades are looking for him."**

You stop.

The Blades.

So they're getting closer.

Erevane lays a light hand on your back.

**"Not here."**

You nod.

He's right.

Not here.

Not in front of these people.

Not yet.

sorn_fixe.title: Staring Back
sorn_fixe.text:
You lift your head.

The murmurs die out one by one.

The light around you grows colder.

More violet.

A fruit stall wilts.

A windowpane cracks.

No one moves.

You didn't want to frighten them.

But part of you is relieved that they've gone quiet.

That part disgusts you.

Erevane gently takes you by the arm.

**"Come."**

Not an order.

A rescue.

You follow him.

auberge_sorn.title: The Inn
auberge_sorn.text:
You and Erevane take a room upstairs.

Erevane shutters the windows.

Not to lock you in.

To shield you from stares.

That's what he says.

You sit on the bed.

The black blade rests on your knees.

It hums softly.

Downstairs, conversations resume.

Lower.

Faster.

Then a sound outside.

Hooves.

A voice you know.

Aryn.

demander_erevane.title: What to Do
demander_erevane.text:
**"What do I do?"**

Erevane looks at the door.

Then at you.

**"Whatever you want."**

The answer irritates you.

**"This is not the time."**

**"Exactly."**

He steps closer.

**"All your life, they'll tell you it isn't the time to choose."**
**"That you're too dangerous."**
**"Too wounded."**
**"Too unstable."**

Downstairs, a chair falls over.

**"So choose now."**

You stand up.

les_quatre_arrivent.title: They're Here
les_quatre_arrivent.text:
The Four are in the street.

Aryn in front.
Taera just behind her.
Vael on the rooftop opposite.
Ikar in the middle of the road.

They look exhausted.

Filthy.
Wounded.

As if they haven't slept in days.

Your heart tightens despite yourself.

Then Ikar lifts his eyes to the window.

He sees you.

For a moment.

Relief.

Then he sees Erevane behind you.

Everything changes.

His blade catches fire.

rester_pres_erevane.title: Beside Erevane
rester_pres_erevane.text:
You don't go down.

Not yet.

Erevane stays calm.

Too calm.

Downstairs, Ikar shouts:

**"Get away from him!"**

Not: *come back.*
Not: *we need to talk.*

Get away from him.

As if you were incapable of choosing who to stay with.

As if you still belonged to their decision.

Erevane lowers his eyes.

**"I'm sorry."**

**"For what?"**

He doesn't answer.

That's worse than any answer.

descendre_rue.title: The Red Street
descendre_rue.text:
You go down.

The street is empty.

The shutters are closed.

The residents watch anyway.

They always do.

Aryn takes a step toward you.

**"We're not here to drag you back by force."**

You want to believe her.

Then Ikar points his blade at Erevane.

**"Him, though, he's coming with us."**

Erevane doesn't move.

He doesn't hide behind you.

He doesn't beg.

He waits.

pourquoi_erevane.title: Why Him
pourquoi_erevane.text:
**"Why him?"**

Aryn answers too quickly.

**"Because he's manipulating you."**

The word strikes you.

*Manipulating.*

**"How do you know?"**

**"Because we know him."** Aryn says.
**"Erevane has been around for a long time."**
**"Too long."**
**"He was already there in Caël's time."**

The ground gives way beneath you.

**"What?"**

**"He wasn't old back then."**
**"But he was there."**
**"He told him the same thing."**
**"A different prophecy."**
**"A different path."**
**"Far from the four sages."**

**"And Caël..."**

**"Caël followed him."** Aryn says.
**"And he destroyed everything."**
**"Alone."**

devant_erevane.title: In Front of Him
devant_erevane.text:
You step in front of Erevane.

The black blade in your hand.

Aryn goes pale.

**"Don't do this."**

**"Me?"**

You laugh.

Not because it's funny.

**"You arrive armed."**
**"You threaten the only man who told me the truth."**
**"And I'm the one doing something?"**

Ikar grits his teeth.

**"He's lying."**

**"Like you?"**

No one answers quickly enough.

That second is enough.

ikar_attaque.title: The Mistake
ikar_attaque.narrator: The fire moves before the words do.
ikar_attaque.text:
Ikar attacks.

Not you.

Erevane.

He crosses the street like a flame let loose.

Too fast for Aryn to stop him.
Too fast for Taera to cry out.
Too fast for Vael to drop from the roof.

Erevane doesn't even raise his hands.

The old man stays where he is.

Frail.
Upright.
Sad.

**"No."** he says.

Not to Ikar.

To you.

**"Not for me."**

But it's too late.

Your black blade rises.

bloquer_ikar.title: The Block
bloquer_ikar.text:
Your blade blocks Ikar's.

Fire against void.

The street vanishes in a violet flash.

The windows explode.
The paving stones heave up.
A wall collapses further down.

Someone screams.

Ikar steps back three paces.

His eyes never leave Erevane.

**"Move aside."**

**"No."**

**"You don't understand what he's doing."**

**"I understand exactly."**

And that is the problem.

You think you understand.

repousser_tous.title: The Wave
repousser_tous.text:
You don't block.

You push away.

Everything.

A violet wave bursts out of you.

Ikar is hurled against a fountain.
Aryn skids across the paving stones.
Taera raises a wall of earth that cracks at once.
Vael vanishes just before he's struck.

The houses tremble.

A chimney falls.

A voice calls for help behind a shutter.

You hear it.

But you can't stop fast enough.

When the silence returns,
the Red City bears a black scar.

accuser_quatre.title: From the Start
accuser_quatre.text:
**"From the start..."**

Your voice shakes.

So does the blade.

**"From the start, you were just waiting for a reason."**

Aryn shakes her head.

**"No."**

Too weak.

Too late.

**"Ikar had his blade at my throat."**
**"Now you want to kill Erevane."**
**"And after that?"**

Taera is crying.

**"We want to bring you back."**

**"No."**

The word comes out like a fracture.

**"You want me to become someone you can keep watch over."**

aryn_supplie.title: Aryn
aryn_supplie.text:
Aryn steps forward despite the blade.

Despite the light.

Despite the fear.

**"I'm begging you."**

Her voice breaks.

You had never heard her like this.

**"He's using your pain."**
**"I know we frightened you."**
**"I know Ikar did something unforgivable."**

Ikar closes his eyes.

**"But Erevane doesn't want to save you."**

Erevane doesn't answer.

He doesn't need to.

Because behind Aryn,
Ikar is already raising his blade.

erevane_parle.title: The Last Sweet Word
erevane_parle.text:
Erevane rests a hand on your shoulder.

Light.

Barely there.

**"You don't need to defend me."** he says.

The Four freeze.

Even Vael.

Because they hear what you don't hear yet.

The perfect trap.

Erevane goes on:

**"You no longer need to prove you deserve to exist."**

The sentence runs through you.

It finds every wound.

Every single one.

**"The world asked you to be small."**
**"To be calm."**
**"To be forgivable."**

His hand tightens, just slightly.

**"You can be real."**

resister_dernier.title: Resist
resister_dernier.text:
You resist.

One second.

Two.

You think of Aryn.
Of Taera.
Of Vael.
Even of Ikar.

You think of what they were before the fear.

Hands held out.
Meals shared.
Silences that weighed less.

The violet light dims.

Aryn sees it.

She reaches out her hand.

And behind her, a city guard looses an arrow.

Not at you.

At Erevane.

Chaos feels it.

Your fear chooses before you do.

chaos_repond.title: Chaos Answers
chaos_repond.text:
The world opens.

Not like a wound.

Like an eye.

The violet light swallows the street.

You hear the voices of the ruins.
The erased dead.
The forgotten names.
Cendral.
Marek.
The bridge.
Sorn.
Everything.

You wanted to be heard.

Now everyone hears.

The Four stagger back.

Not by choice.

By force.

Behind you, Erevane murmurs:

**"Yes."**

A single word.

Too joyful.

Too true.

And for the first time,
you are afraid of him.

revelation_erevane.title: The Truth
revelation_erevane.text:
You turn around.

Erevane's eyes are full of tears.

But they are not tears of fear.

They are the tears of someone
who finally sees what he has been waiting for.

**"I'm sorry."** he says.

**"No, you're not."**

He lowers his head.

**"No."**

**"Your brother."**

**"He died because of Caël."**
**"And you spent three hundred years..."**

**"Searching for another bearer."**
**"One who would finish what Caël did not."**

He raises his eyes.

**"Chaos should not be contained."**
**"It should be set free."**
**"Completely."**
**"Once and for all."**
**"So that Aerith can begin again."**
**"From the start."**
**"Without the mistakes of the past."**

The blade trembles.

It understands before you do.

**"You never wanted to help me."**
**"You wanted to use Chaos."**

**"Yes."**

One word.

The worst thing anyone has ever said to you.

mensonge_erevane.title: The Lie
mensonge_erevane.text:
**"You lied to me."**

Erevane shakes his head.

**"Never about what matters."**

**"You wanted to use me."**

**"I wanted to set free what you carry."**

**"I'm not Chaos."**

This time, he looks at you with a sadness that is almost sincere.

**"No."**

He says it like a blessing.

**"You are what has held it back until now."**

The sentence destroys you.

Because you understand.

The Four wanted to save you.

Erevane wanted to save Chaos.

And you chose the one who knew better how to talk.

combat_contre_quatre.title: Four Against One
combat_contre_quatre.text:
The Four regroup.

Aryn wipes blood from her temple.
Taera holds her arm against her chest.
Vael has no jokes left in his eyes.
Ikar gets up with difficulty.

They are wounded.

They stay.

Because of course they stay.

Aryn shouts your name.

Your true name.

Not *bearer of Chaos.*

Not *prophecy.*

Your name.

For a moment, you hear it.

Then the voices beneath the world shout louder.

The black blade rises.

combat_aryn.title: The Water
combat_aryn.text:
Aryn arrives first.

Not to strike.

To slow you down.

Her water wraps around your blade.

It whispers something.

You can't make it out.

A prayer, perhaps.
Or your name.

You push back.

The water turns black for a second.

Aryn is thrown against the paving stones.

She doesn't get up right away.

Taera cries out.

The city trembles.

You want to stop.

Chaos does not.

combat_taera.title: Earth
combat_taera.text:
Taera raises walls.

Not around you.

Around the townspeople.

She is still protecting them.

Even now.

Even from you.

You strike.

The first wall holds.

The second too.

The third cracks.

Taera falls to her knees.

Her hands bleed onto the stone.

She looks at you.

Not with fear.

With grief.

**"Come back."**

One word.

You almost want to obey.

Then Erevane coughs behind you.

Wounded.
Frail.

Anger returns.

combat_vael.title: Air
combat_vael.text:
Vael vanishes.

Reappears behind you.

For the first time, he isn't joking.

**"That's not you talking."**

You laugh.

The sound doesn't resemble your voice.

**"How long have you known me, Vael?"**

He takes the words like a blow.

**"Long enough to know you're suffering."**

**"Everyone suffers."**

**"Yes."**

He smiles sadly.

**"But not everyone has an apocalyptic sword to cope with it so badly."**

It should have made you laugh.

It could have.

In another life.

combat_ikar.title: Fire
combat_ikar.text:
Ikar arrives last.

Of course he does.

Fire against Chaos.

His face is covered in dust.

A cut runs across his cheek.

He doesn't look at Erevane.

Not anymore.

He looks at you.

**"It's my fault."**

The sentence splits something open inside you.

**"Yes."**

He nods.

He accepts it.

**"But I'm not going to let you vanish because of me."**

He attacks.

This time, not to kill.

To hold you back.

But holding back a storm with bare hands
is still a way of dying.

les_quatre_tombent.title: They Fall
les_quatre_tombent.text:
One by one,
they fall.

Not dead.

Not yet.

But beaten.

Aryn against the steps of the inn.
Taera beside the wall she raised for the townspeople.
Vael on a shattered rooftop.
Ikar on his knees in front of you.

He is still trying to get up.

Of course he is.

You point the blade at him.

He doesn't lower his eyes.

**"Come back."** he says.

Not an order.

A plea.

Too late.

Too human.

Chaos roars.

epargner_ikar.title: Too Late to Come Back
epargner_ikar.text:
You lower the blade.

One second.

Ikar sees it.

Aryn does too.

Taera reaches out a hand.

Even Vael lifts his head.

There is still something.

A thread.

Thin.
Almost invisible.

Then Erevane speaks behind you:

**"They'll do it again."**

The sentence cuts the thread.

You close your eyes.

When you open them,
the violet light has swallowed everything.

You spared Ikar.

But you didn't come back.

chaos_gagne.title: Chaos Wins
chaos_gagne.text:
The sky bends.

Not really.

But everyone who looks at it would swear it does.

The violet light rises from the broken street.

The Four can no longer move.

Erevane walks up to you.

Slowly.

Like a priest approaching an altar.

**"You see?"** he murmurs.

His voice trembles.

**"This was not the end."**

You look around.

The Red City.
The hidden inhabitants.
The Four on the ground.
Erevane behind you.

And at last you understand.

You didn't win your freedom.

You only changed cages.

trop_tard.title: Too Late
trop_tard.text:
The Four wanted to save you.

Erevane wanted to save Chaos.

The difference is immense.

You see it now.

Now that Aryn can no longer reach out her hand.
Now that Taera can no longer protect the street.
Now that Vael has nothing left to say.
Now that Ikar has lowered his blade.

Now that there is no one left between you
and what you carry.

You want to step back.

You want to say their names.

You want to be someone who can still be brought back.

But Chaos does not look back.

fin_catastrophe.title: The Sacred Catastrophe
fin_catastrophe.text:
Later, people will say Sorn survived.

Technically.

The walls still stand.
The streets still exist.

But Sorn is no longer a city.

It is a scar.

Chaos crossed Aerith like an idea
that can no longer be undone.

Erevane got what he wanted.

Three hundred years of waiting.

For this.

The Four are alive.

Somewhere.

Aryn is still searching.

Taera is replanting.

Vael walks through places where the air is different.

Ikar has not sheathed his blade.

They are looking for a way to repair things.

It is not certain that one exists.

But they keep looking.

Because that is what they do.

Because that is what they have always done.

And you.

You are here.

Somewhere in all of this.

The black blade cold in your hand.

You remember Erevane saying:
*Chaos is not a curse. It is a gift.*

You remember Taera's seed.

Two blows on the anvil.

Marek's knife.

Those things were not destroyed.

They still exist.

Somewhere.

Maybe this is a beginning.

Maybe.

detail_cloche.title: Something
detail_cloche.text:
Erevane knows too much.

Not generalities.

Details.

Marek's name.
The color of Aryn's blade.
The exact moment Chaos awoke.

**"How do you know all this?"**

He stirs the embers.

**"I have studied Chaos for a long time."**

**"How long?"**

A pause.

A short one.

**"Very long."**

He doesn't look at you as he says it.

You file the observation away.

Without knowing yet what to do with it.

remarquer_changement.title: The Mirror
remarquer_changement.text:
You see your reflection in a pool.

You stop.

Your eyes.

They have a tint.

Violet.

Faint.

As if the blade were starting to bleed its color into you.

You think of Taera.

*The earth knows when someone is empty.*

You think of Aryn.

*Chaos is in you, but you are greater than Chaos.*

You think of Vael.

*People who arrive at just the right moment with exactly the right answers.*

You put these thoughts aside.

Erevane calls to you from the clearing.

You follow.

voix_erevane.title: His Voice
voix_erevane.text:
**"A bridge can be rebuilt."**

He says it too easily.

As if he has said that sentence many times.

Not to console you.

To move on.

**"What matters is that you learn."**

*What matters.*

Not the child.
Not the merchant.
Not the bridge.

*What matters is that you learn.*

You can't tell whether it's wisdom or something else.

You look at Erevane.

He is already turning a page of his book.

He has already moved on.

observer_erevane_sorn.title: Watching Him
observer_erevane_sorn.text:
Erevane is calm.

Too calm.

Outside, the city murmurs his name.
The Four are somewhere in the streets.

He reads.

An old book.
Not the one he showed you.

Another.

Its cover is different.

Not black.

Dark red.

He closes it when he sees you looking.

**"An old treatise."** he says.
**"Dull."**

He smiles.

His usual smile.

But his eyes go to the door for a second.

As if he were waiting for something.

erevane_confirme.title: The Confirmation
erevane_confirme.text:
You turn toward Erevane.

**"Is it true?"**

He doesn't answer right away.

That silence.

That silence says everything.

**"I was there."** he says at last.
**"But Caël had made his own choices."**

**"You told him the same thing you told me."**

**"I told the truth."**

**"Your truth."**

He doesn't deny it.

He doesn't confirm it either.

That is not the same as lying.

But it isn't the truth either.

And you know it now.

You know it.
